name: Red Embrace: Hollywood
source:
Los Angeles, California, 1996. A young newcomer is turned into a vampire
and thrust into the dark underbelly of society, forced to sink or swim.
You are that newcomer.

[From [url=https://argent-games.itch.io/red-embrace-hollywood] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1996年，加利福尼亚州洛杉矶。一名年轻的新人变成吸血鬼，被推入社会的黑暗底层，只能被迫挣扎求生。你就是那名新人。

[来源：[url=https://argent-games.itch.io/red-embrace-hollywood]itch.io[/url]]
